gates.balance_chain: CLOSES WITHIN EACH REPORT AND ACROSS ALL THREE. Report 1: 640.20 contributed - 640.20 spent = 0, and the cover's balance line is a slashed-zero glyph (=0) in all three columns. Report 2: its TOTALS FROM LAST REPORT cells are 640.20 for contributions AND 640.20 for expenses, chaining exactly to report 1's cumulative figures; nothing moves this period (both THIS cells are slashed zeros), leaving cumulative 640.20 / 640.20 and a zero balance. Report 3: its LAST cells are again 640.20 / 640.20, chaining exactly to report 2's cumulative figures, nothing moves, cumulative 640.20 / 640.20, zero balance. Unlike the other bundle in this chunk (f3f2dc07), THIS bundle is stapled in correct chronological order, and the chain confirms it: no swapped cover.

notes: A THREE-REPORT BUNDLE in correct chronological order: report 1 (pp.1-3) covers 1/2/24 to 6-18-24, report 2 (pp.4-6) covers 6/18/24 to 10/21/24, report 3 (pp.7-9) covers 10.21.24 to 1-6.25. The chunk file's n_reports=3 AGREES. TWO COVER GENERATIONS INSIDE ONE PDF: report 1 uses the older county-branded cover with FOUR money lines (including the '$50.00 or less' aggregate) and a candidate contact block, while reports 2 and 3 use the newer THREE-line cover with no aggregate line and an Office Use Only clerk block - so cover_le50_* are real zeros on report 1 and null (field absent) on reports 2 and 3. SCHEDULE PAGES OUT OF ORDER IN REPORT 2: page 5 is the Itemized EXPENDITURE Report (Form 'B') and page 6 is the Itemized CONTRIBUTION Report (Form 'A') - the reverse of the A-then-B order used by reports 1 and 3 and by every other document in this chunk. Both were read as what their own titles say, not as their position implies. Chunk file says candidate 'DAVID WHITEHEAD', office 'Treasurer'; all three covers and all six schedule headers read 'DAVID WHITEHEAD' / 'TREASURER' - AGREE throughout. The only itemized money in the whole bundle is the candidate's own $640.20 self-contribution on 1/2/24 and the matching $640.20 county filing fee on the same day. Every In Kind? cell in the bundle except p2 row 1 (answered 'N') is blank. Candidate street address, ZIP, personal email and phone are printed in the clear on the report-1 cover and were discarded at read time; on the Form A row the donor is the candidate himself, so only the city (Santa Clara) was kept - the schedule prints no state for him, so donor_state is honestly blank rather than inferred.
